def solve(case):
    matrix = case["matrix"]
    idf = case["idf"]
    vector = case["vector"]
    n_rows = len(matrix)
    n_cols = len(idf)
    for row in matrix:
        if len(row) != n_cols:
            raise ValueError
    if len(vector) != n_rows:
        raise ValueError
    scaled = [[row[j] * idf[j] for j in range(n_cols)] for row in matrix]
    degrees = [sum(x*x for x in row) for row in scaled]
    floor = 1e-12
    deg_inv_sqrt = [1.0 / math.sqrt(max(d, floor)) for d in degrees]
    v_scaled = [vector[i] * deg_inv_sqrt[i] for i in range(n_rows)]
    xt_v = [0.0] * n_cols
    for j in range(n_cols):
        s = 0.0
        for i in range(n_rows):
            s += scaled[i][j] * v_scaled[i]
        xt_v[j] = s
    x_xt_v = [0.0] * n_rows
    for i in range(n_rows):
        s = 0.0
        for j in range(n_cols):
            s += scaled[i][j] * xt_v[j]
        x_xt_v[i] = s
    result = [x_xt_v[i] * deg_inv_sqrt[i] for i in range(n_rows)]
    degree_out = [round(d, 8) for d in degrees]
    result_out = [round(r, 8) for r in result]
    return {"degree": degree_out, "result": result_out}"}
